You are reviewing one file from a company's data room, before an investment.
Run each check below over every passage. Report only what the text states.
Do not report the terms of the proposed transaction itself (buyer, stake, price): the investor
already knows them. Report what those terms trigger elsewhere.

Checks:
- change_of_control: A clause that changes or ends an agreement if the company's owners change (repayment, termination, consent needed).
- legal_claims: A legal claim, lawsuit, threatened proceedings or dispute involving the company.
- contracts_ending: A customer, supplier or financing contract that ends within 12 months of October 2026, or has no renewal agreed.
- unpaid_taxes: Taxes owed, overdue or disputed.
- covenant_breach: A loan condition (covenant) that is broken, or within 10% of its limit.
- customer_concentration: One customer above 20% of revenue.
- other: Any other fact a careful investor would want to know before investing, that the checks above don't cover.

For each finding return: check_id, observation (one factual sentence, no advice), unit_id, quote.
A finding can cite only one passage. If a check finds nothing in this file, return nothing for it.

Return JSON: {"findings": [...]}

Rules:
- Use only the passages given. Never use outside knowledge.
- Copy quotes exactly, word for word, from one passage. Keep a quote short: the sentence or table row that holds the figure.
- Report facts only. Never give advice, opinions or recommendations.
- Return valid JSON only.

File 01_your_deck.pdf:
[01_your_deck:p1:u1] (01_your_deck.pdf p.1, Fintech A: Investor Presentation > Payments and reconciliation for mid-size retailers) Confidential. Prepared for prospective co-investors. October 2026.
[01_your_deck:p2:u1] (01_your_deck.pdf p.2, Fintech A: Investor Presentation > Company) Founded in 2014. 3 offices: London, Manchester, Dublin.
[01_your_deck:p3:u1] (01_your_deck.pdf p.3, Fintech A: Investor Presentation > The problem we solve) Mid-size retailers run payments and reconciliation in separate tools. Finance teams close the month by matching card settlements to orders by hand.
[01_your_deck:p4:u1] (01_your_deck.pdf p.4, Fintech A: Investor Presentation > Financials) Revenue FY2025: $38.0M. Profitable and growing.
[01_your_deck:p5:u1] (01_your_deck.pdf p.5, Fintech A: Investor Presentation > Unit economics) Gross margin: 68%. Net revenue retention: 115%.
[01_your_deck:p6:u1] (01_your_deck.pdf p.6, Fintech A: Investor Presentation > Customers) 410 customers across the UK and Ireland. Largest customer: 31% of revenue.
[01_your_deck:p7:u1] (01_your_deck.pdf p.7, Fintech A: Investor Presentation > Product) 3 products: FinPay, FinRecon, FinInsights.
[01_your_deck:p8:u1] (01_your_deck.pdf p.8, Fintech A: Investor Presentation > Team) 240 employees. Led by CEO Daniel Okafor and CFO Priya Raman.
[01_your_deck:p9:u1] (01_your_deck.pdf p.9, Fintech A: Investor Presentation > Financing) Senior term loan: $25.0M.
[01_your_deck:p10:u1] (01_your_deck.pdf p.10, Fintech A: Investor Presentation > The transaction) Northgate Capital Partners is acquiring a 30% stake for $60.0M. Co-investment is available.

findings.observation: The company's largest customer accounts for 31% of revenue.
